jobs.reason: Trading Operations Specialist at a top quant firm aligns with the candidate's trading-operations interest and Python/Linux skills, but the posting requires 3+ years of professional experience and domain knowledge (PNL/risk reporting, market structure) the candidate lacks. Critically, the role is located in Grand Cayman, not the US, which conflicts with the candidate's US work-authorization (OPT/H-1B) needs and stated US-only target. Sponsorship is not mentioned. Overall a stretch.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.location_summary: Hybrid from Chicago office or fully remote; final round interviews onsite in Chicago
jobs.reason: The role is a strong skills match on paper (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD, Linux, Python/Bash, observability) and aligns with the candidate's platform/SRE interests at a trading firm. However, it explicitly requires 3+ years of platform/cloud/SRE/DevOps experience plus deep production Kubernetes (including on-prem and EKS), cloud-native data services, and demonstrated technical leadership/mentoring, which the candidate's ~1-2 years of infrastructure experience does not meet. The posting also directs current students/recent grads to separate entry-level positions, and sponsorship is not mentioned. This is a stretch rather than a good fit.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Voice AI (Inference Runtime)
jobs.location_raw: San Francisco, Toronto, New York, Montreal, Seattle
jobs.location_summary: San Francisco, Toronto, New York, Montreal, Seattle
jobs.reason: The role is an AI inference runtime engineering position at an AI infrastructure company, which aligns with the candidate's stated interest in AI inference/infrastructure. However, it requires a proven track record owning production-grade real-time large-scale systems where p99 tail latency matters, plus deep specialization in GPU runtime optimization, model serving runtimes, and speech/audio ML that the candidate lacks. The candidate's experience is entry-level (systems administration, full-stack, CI/CD) with only project-level Kubernetes/observability work, so this is a stretch. Sponsorship is not mentioned in the posting.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations System Engineer (Kansas City)
jobs.location_summary: Kansas City, MO - Data Center; requires presence 5 days a week, shift work, with travel for new data center bring-up
jobs.reason: This is a hands-on data center operations role focused on physical infrastructure (racking, cabling, power, cooling, DCIM, inventory) rather than the software infrastructure/SRE/platform work the candidate targets. The candidate's Linux, troubleshooting, and networking knowledge partially match, but the role requires Spanish fluency and physical data center operations experience the candidate lacks, and it is onsite shift work in Kansas City. It is entry-level and could be a foot in the door at an AI infrastructure company, but it is a stretch relative to the candidate's software infrastructure profile.

However, this is a mid-level forward-deployed role requiring 3+ years including production ownership and direct customer-facing engineering, plus deep specialization in GPU workloads, model serving stacks (vLLM/SGLang), distributed compute, and Physical AI/robotics simulation that the candidate lacks. The candidate's ~2 years of experience and absence of customer-facing or GPU-serving experience make this a stretch rather than a good fit. Sponsorship is not mentioned in the posting, so it is unknown.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Post-Training Inference
jobs.location_summary: San Francisco, CA (onsite; no remote/hybrid mentioned)
jobs.reason: This is a mid-level research engineering role focused on post-training/inference infrastructure for LLMs, requiring 2+ years deploying ML services in production plus hands-on experience with inference engines (SGLang, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM), fine-tuning, and RL workloads. The candidate has strong general infra skills (Python, Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability) and some LLM/RAG exposure, but lacks the specialized inference-engine, fine-tuning, RL, and CUDA/kernel experience the role demands. It is also an onsite SF role at a senior-leaning research team, and the posting does not mention sponsorship, which is a concern given the candidate's future H-1B need. Fit is poor relative to entry/junior infra roles.
